en: Hungry squishies sit at the counter and show what they want.
Tap a food at the bottom to cook it in a free pan.
When it is ready, tap the dish, then tap the squishy who ordered it (or drag it to them).
Serve before their patience bar runs out. Lose 3 customers and the shift is over.
It never ends: guests come faster and order more the longer you last.
and carry on with 1 heart, every guest's patience full again
